fields.description: Evaluated top to bottom by distance — the tier with the smallest Max Distance that the visit's distance still fits under wins. The tier with Max Distance left at 0 is treated as unbounded (matches any distance no earlier tier covers).
fields.label: Pricing Tiers

fields.description: One Site Visit can be booked per slot per day — this is what makes multiple visits on the same day possible (one per slot) while still blocking a double-booking within the same slot. Add, remove, rename, or retime slots freely; a day's capacity is simply however many slots are configured here.
fields.label: Daily Slots
